scientific_checks: The plane is introduced as one linear equality in three energy coordinates; S is its physical subset.
The torque-response curve is a family of endpoints with fixed initial state and duration, not one time trajectory.
The integrated chain rule is an exact identity of the physical flow. Periodic energy and dynamics remain consistent across angle wrapping.
The predictor integrates f and evaluates H; no explicit online Jacobian operation or inverse is invented.
Curve-plane intersection is equivalent to W_Delta=w only for the stated exact lossless model.
A lack of intersections is stated for bounded held torque over the prescribed duration.
Numerical integration error and incomplete finite root sampling are identified.
All candidates retain common scoring; no hard arm filtering or root-first selection is claimed.
No electrical-efficiency, stability, global-optimality, or continuous-time arm-containment claim is introduced.
